mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 2%, it signals a strong labor market and economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS YoY growth > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising simultaneously, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a weakening supply chain and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 1% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a potential inflationary environment that may lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in real GDP (GDPC1) is negative and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a potential recessionary environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY < 0 and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
